text:
Avery: New Orchard POC seeing flaky TTFT during an internal demo. p50 usually ~160ms, now jumping to 700-1200ms after a 90s burst.
Diego: hosted or dedicated? any recent config changes?
Avery: hosted, trial org. They enabled prefill from our quickstart and set a small batch window.
infra-bot: runtime v2.13.4 deployed to us-west-2 at 08:10 PT. No infra alerts.
Priya: what's the prefill config and client concurrency? small batch windows + concurrency can cause KV write/read races.
Avery: config posted by customer: `prefill: enabled, prefill_batch_window_ms: 180, max_prefill_tokens: 512`, concurrency ~14, model `redwood-2-8b-quant`.
Marta: any 429s or rate-limit headers during the spike?
Avery: they saw brief 429s during the stress run, then latency spikes.
Diego: ask them to run session diag: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/diag/session/<sid>?fields=queue,kvcache,rate` and paste key lines.
Avery: customer returned: `queue_wait_ms=395, kvcache_hit=false, backend_ms=89, x-ratelimit-remaining=77`.
Priya: kvcache_hit=false plus high queue_wait -> classic prefill KV thrash. Small prefill batches create many writes that race with reads across shards.
Diego: mitigation options: 1) temporarily disable prefill to confirm baseline; 2) increase `prefill_batch_window_ms` to 800-1000ms; 3) enable `prefill_strict_sequencing` to serialize prefill per session (safer but slower prefill).
Marta: customer asking if we can credit POC days affected. Sales-ops, is a goodwill credit option available?
sales-ops: we can offer a conditional one-day hosted credit if instability persists after our guided config change and 24h monitor; need deal owner OK.
Avery: customer did a quick disable test and reported p50 ~200ms, no 429s during a 5-min replay.
Priya: that points to prefill interaction. Plan: controlled re-enable with `prefill_batch_window_ms=1000` TOM 09:00 PT while we watch KV hit-rate and per-shard queue_wait_ms.
Diego: I'll prepare a short runbook and be on the 09:00 call to tail shard queues. If instability returns, revert to disabling prefill.
Marta: I'll draft the customer email: summarize experiment, include API patch and diag command, offer conditional credit, and schedule guided re-enable.
Avery: include this API snippet in the email to apply: 
```
PATCH /v1/projects/<proj>/settings
{ "prefill": { "enabled": true, "prefill_batch_window_ms": 1000, "prefill_strict_sequencing": false } }
```
Diego: also ask them to capture `x-ratelimit-*` headers if they see errors.
Priya: follow-ups: ["monitor kvcache hit-rate during re-enable","capture per-shard queue metrics","verify x-ratelimit headers and any 429s","prepare rollback to disable prefill quickly"]
Marta: noted. I'll loop in deal owner for credit approval and drop meeting invite.
Avery: customer agreed to the 09:00 PT controlled re-enable and invited their infra lead. Thanks team :thumbsup:
